name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: store-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in for registered shoppers and the store admin; role (shopper vs admin) is resolved from the caller's Thunder groups.

dependencies.name: stripe
dependencies.description: Processes checkout payment charges; no card data is stored by this service.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create and confirm payment charges.

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, carts, orders (including immutable line-item/shipping snapshots), and shopper accounts; the checkout stock-decrement + order-create write is a single transaction against this database.

description: Owns the product catalog, cart, checkout/order processing (Stripe payment plus atomic stock decrement), account data, and admin order/reporting endpoints for the ceramics store. Persists all data in the platform-provisioned ceramics-db PostgreSQL database. Does not issue auth tokens (Thunder does) and does not call any carrier/shipping API.
